name: bada-pharma
description: Bada Pharma — a pharmaceutical manufacturing-line simulator. Readings from the instrument apps (MRI/fMRI, DNA analysis, blood chemistry, brain electromagnetic field, brain topography, Gamma thermal sensing) are bound into one profile that drives target identification, fragment-based molecular design, a retrosynthetic plan limited to yields and atom economy, tablet formulation with dissolution, one-compartment pharmacokinetics, quality control and a batch record. Conceptual simulation; not medical software and not usable for actual manufacture. No reagents, conditions or procedures.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
